  id: noncompliant-device-report
  name: Noncompliant device report
  description: Reviews managed devices and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Reads managed devices from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - complianceState
        - userPrincipalName
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short devices report.
    settings:
      system: >-

      prompt: >-
        Total managed devices: {{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}. Details: {{ load_managed_devices.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding,

      maxTokens: 400

    - id: manual
      kind: manual

    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("No summary available.") }}'

      total: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}'

descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly group inventory
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Reads groups from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_grouptypes

    label: Count groups by groupTypes
    detail: Breaks groups down by groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Unified
        - DynamicMembership

    format: llm
    label: Summarize
    detail: Generates a short groups report.

      system: >-
        You review groups for Microsoft 365 admins and report findings for them to review before anything happens. Be concise, factual, and conservative. Use only
        the supplied data.

      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800

    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable") }}'

      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
